```{r} library(tidyverse) library(maps) library(ggplot2) library(sf) library(leaflet) library(ggplot2) ``` ```{r} auto_assembly_plants <- read_csv("../data/Industrial Institutions/Auto_Assembly_Plants_Wikipedia.csv") EV_manufacturing_facilities <- read_csv("../data/Industrial Institutions/Clean_EV_ManufacturingFacilities.csv") ``` ```{r} # filtering dataset to only Vehicle Assembly facilities to match with the wiki page clean_EVs <- EV_manufacturing_facilities %>% filter(`Component Category` == "Vehicle Assembly") clean_EVs ``` ```{r} auto_manufacturer_counts <- auto_assembly_plants %>% count(Manufacturer, sort = TRUE) ggplot(auto_manufacturer_counts, aes(x = n, y = reorder(Manufacturer, n))) + geom_col() + labs( title = "Auto Assembly Plants by Manufacturer", x = "Manufacturer", y = "Number of plants" ) + theme_minimal() ev_parent_counts <- clean_EVs %>% filter(!is.na(`Parent Company`)) %>% count(`Parent Company`, sort = TRUE) %>% slice_max(n, n = 15) ggplot(ev_parent_counts, aes(x = n, y = reorder(`Parent Company`, n))) + geom_col() + labs( title = "Top EV Manufacturing Parent Companies", x = "Parent company", y = "Number of facilities" ) + theme_minimal() ``` ```{r} ev_timeline <- clean_EVs %>% filter(!is.na(`Announcement Effective Year`)) %>% mutate(year = as.integer(`Announcement Effective Year`)) %>% count(year) ggplot(ev_timeline, aes(x = year, y = n)) + geom_col() + labs( title = "EV Manufacturing Announcements by Year", x = "Announcement year", y = "Number of announcements" ) + theme_minimal() ``` ```{r} # checking rows with empty city values clean_EVs %>% filter(is.na(City) | City == "") %>% select(Company, `Facility Name`, State) # cleaning those rows ev_map <- clean_EVs %>% filter(!is.na(City), City != "") # changing Ontario facility coordinates from Canada to California ev_map <- clean_EVs %>% mutate( latitude = if_else( Company == "Cenntro Automotive", 34.0633, latitude ), longitude = if_else( Company == "Cenntro Automotive", -117.6509, longitude ) ) auto_map <- auto_assembly_plants %>% filter(Address != "TBA") ``` ```{r} # creating a clean joined dataset ev_map_clean <- ev_map %>% mutate( company = Company, facility_name = `Facility Name`, city = City, state = State, address = Address, latitude = latitude, longitude = longitude, products_or_focus = `Manufacturing Focus`, source_dataset = "EV manufacturing", EV_facility = TRUE, .keep = "none" ) auto_map_clean <- auto_map %>% mutate( company = Manufacturer, facility_name = `Plant Name`, city = NA_character_, state = NA_character_, address = Address, latitude = latitude, longitude = longitude, products_or_focus = Products, source_dataset = "Auto assembly", EV_facility = FALSE, .keep = "none" ) combined_auto_ev_map <- bind_rows(ev_map_clean, auto_map_clean) ``` ```{r} write_csv(combined_auto_ev_map, "auto_ev_map.csv") ``` ```{r} leaflet() %>% addProviderTiles("CartoDB.Positron") %>% # Auto assembly plants addCircleMarkers( data = auto_map, lng = ~longitude, lat = ~latitude, radius = 5, color = "blue", fillOpacity = 0.7, group = "Auto Assembly Plants", popup = ~paste0( "", `Plant Name`, "
", "Manufacturer: ", Manufacturer, "
", "Address: ", Address, "
", "Products: ", Products ) ) %>% # EV manufacturing facilities addCircleMarkers( data = ev_map, lng = ~longitude, lat = ~latitude, radius = 4, color = "red", fillOpacity = 0.6, group = "EV Manufacturing Facilities", popup = ~paste0( "", `Facility Name`, "
", "Company: ", Company, "
", "Parent Company: ", `Parent Company`, "
", "City: ", City, ", ", State, "
", "Component Category: ", `Component Category`, "
", "Manufacturing Focus: ", `Manufacturing Focus` ) ) %>% addLayersControl( overlayGroups = c("Auto Assembly Plants", "EV Manufacturing Facilities"), options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE) ) ```
